android.desc:
Fraksl turns your device into a real-time fractal visual engine. Powered by live video feedback, it transforms simple inputs into endlessly evolving, mesmerizing patterns — perfect for live performances, music visuals, generative art, and creative exploration.

FILTERS & MIRRORS
Apply color filters and mirror transformations to reshape your fractals into new forms. Combine them with layers and modulators for infinite creative possibilities.

LAYERS
Mix multiple visual sources into your fractals. Use your live camera as input, import images and videos from your library, or receive NDI streams from other apps and devices. Each layer has full control over blend mode, opacity, hue, position, rotation, scale, and chroma keying.

SEQUENCES
Capture bookmarks of your visual state — filter, mirror, color, and more. Arrange them into sequences with custom transition and hold times for smooth, cinematic playback. Export and share your sequences with others.

MODULATORS
Automate any parameter with real-time signal sources:

Audio — react to sound from your microphone
MIDI — connect hardware controllers and DAWs
Beat Clock — sync to BPM with adjustable divisions
Waveform — generate smooth LFO patterns
Motion — use your device's gyroscope and accelerometer
Gamepad — connect any controller for hands-on performance

Create complex, evolving visuals that respond to music, movement, or external control.

CAPTURE & RECORDING
Take high-resolution screenshots or record video with optional microphone audio. Share directly from the app.

NDI STREAMING
Stream your output live over the network to any NDI-compatible software or device. Ideal for live shows, streaming setups, and multi-screen installations.

PRESETS
Save and recall your complete setup — layers, modulators, mappings, sequences, and all settings — in a single tap.

AVAILABLE IN 9 LANGUAGES
English, Dutch, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, and Polish.

FREE TO USE
Fraksl is free with core features included. Unlock additional filters, mirrors, layers, modulators, capture, streaming, and save slots individually or as a full bundle.

The effect produced here looks very much like an Android/IOS app Fraksl [1] I use to play with. It produces the effects with similar delay and is very different from other fun fractal software.

[1]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.workSPACE.Fraksl
[2]: https://emielharmsen.com/portfolio/fraksl/
quotes.story_title: The Light Herder and the Fractal Time Machine

quotes.text:
There is an app on Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.workSPACE.Fraksl which seems to generate fractals using something similar because the final effects looks lot like this video and it's not slow like computed fractals. I played with this app years ago and it feels very different.

Edit: Using some slow pinches you can put the image in a continously looping state like a time crystal.

Edit: someone made a shader that behaves exactly like Fraksl. https://www.shadertoy.com/view/43lfDn
quotes.story_title: Images trapped in a feedback loop and analog fractals create each other
